summary: WHISPERS: Realm of the Nine is a fantasy MMO prototype entered through the MMORPG Tools menu and character-creation flow, with a large Lantern March continent as its playable world. MMORPG Tools owns character/menu lifecycle and UI; the player template composes movement, class combat, quests, and vendor behaviors, while world scripts and procedural builders supply NPCs, enemies, resources, and landmarks.
places: places/main-menu-land/ - title/menu entry place; MMORPG Tools opens realm and character selection here.
places/character-creation-land/ - character preview and creation scene with its own framing camera and lighting.
places/main/ - streamed Lantern March continent; terrain, roads, flattening/lake marks, vegetation and lighting are configured in config.yaml.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Lantern's Reach hub with town buildings, NPCs/talkers, quest interactions and riverside Briarwild scenery.
places/main/cells/x-6z1.scene, x7z-1.scene, x2z11.scene - Thornhollow, Cinderhold and Gullrest starting settlements; corresponding regional names are in scripts/lib/regions.js.
places/main/cells/x-1z0.scene and x-1z-1.scene - Briarwild wolf/gathering country and its added ledge cache; wolf pack and timber interaction use scripts/wolves.js and scripts/quest-player.js.
places/main/cells/x-28z0.scene and x0z0.scene - Elderveil frontier/Reach vicinity and expanded Briarwild river flora; procedural frontier and Briar builders supply scene features.
places/main/cells/x-1z-30.scene, x0z-30.scene, x30z-1.scene and distant route cells - Frostveil, Sunscar and Elderveil landmarks/waystones; frontier content is built by scripts/gen/frontier.js.
roots: world.config.yaml - defaultPlace main-menu-land; binds player/camera templates, MMORPG UI/nametag/arrival, and player interaction plus orbit/steer/autorun inputs.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod.json - registers menu, player lifecycle, character selection, interaction prompts and gameplay/creation camera behaviors.
templates/player.js#player - ordered native behavior chain: humanoid-locomotion, player movement, Vanguard, Arcanist, Pathfinder, quest-player, vendor.
templates/camera.js#camera - core camera template using scripts/camera.js and engine look orientation.
places/main/config.yaml - continent spawn, gravity, procedural terrain/coast, material, flatten/lake/path marks and scatter setup.
shared: mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ - RPG registries, save/UI helpers and modular panels consumed by mod behaviors and ui.js.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/realm-save.js - character-table load/upsert/import/delete/signature helper used by player lifecycle and character selection.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/currency.js and scripts/lib/economy.js - shared copper purse/conversion display; economy move also emits coin-ledger and feedback effects.
scripts/lib/data/quests.yml, townsfolk.yml and wolves.yml - quest/NPC dialogue/pack tuning read by quest-player, townsfolk and wolves behaviors.
scripts/lib/regions.js and scripts/terrain-reach.js - ordered region classification and shared continent height/material/coast functions used by place terrain and HUD region display.

scripts/gen/shape.js and gen/house.js, props.js, tree.js, rock.js, spire.js, stone-bridge.js, farm.js, windmill*.js, frontier.js, briar.js, quarry.js and reach-*.js - procedural geometry used by place instances.
scripts/lib/kit.js and scripts/lib/missiles.js - shared asset-kit and projectile helpers used by builders and class abilities; scripts/gen/arrow.js supplies arrow geometry.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ui-*.js - reusable MMORPG panels, including art/frames, HUD, quests, vendor, inventory, map, menu and character UI, composed by ui.js.
notableExports: scripts/player.js - onInput, update; scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - sit, onInput, update.
scripts/vanguard.js - onInput, endAction, land; scripts/arcanist.js - onInput, release, wardEnd, endAction; scripts/pathfinder.js - class ability handlers.
scripts/quest-player.js - onInput, update; scripts/vendor.js - player coin-event and vendor interaction handlers; scripts/townsfolk.js - resident spawn/update behavior.
scripts/wolves.js - update; scripts/gen/wolf.js - skeleton, geometry; scripts/cache-chest.js - cache open-state presentation.
scripts/lib/economy.js - move, formatting helpers; mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/currency.js - purse/conversion/format helpers.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/realm-save.js - realm character persistence helpers; mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/player.js - RPG player lifecycle and onLeave save.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/quest-data.js - quest lookup/progress helpers; lib/ui-hud.js and lib/ui-quest.js - HUD and quest renderers.
scripts/terrain-reach.js - terrain/coast functions; scripts/lib/regions.js - REGIONS, MARCH, regionAt; scripts/gen/frontier.js - geometry, collider.
ownership: scripts/player.js - room-local movement intent and core velocity/footstep state; place config owns gravity.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - transient gait/turn state, character yaw and animation channels; template order makes gait sample movement velocity.

mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/player.js and realm-save.js - active character state, roster/purse/inventory snapshots and persisted realm character record; character-select/main-menu-mgr own front-door transitions.
scripts/vanguard.js, arcanist.js and pathfinder.js - class-specific cooldown/action/guard state and combat effects; scripts/wolves.js owns den timers and wolf AI/death state.
scripts/quest-player.js - player quest/tally/inventory/xp/dialog/cache state and timber depletion fields; scripts/woodcutting.js owns oak fall/regrowth presentation.
scripts/vendor.js and scripts/lib/economy.js - vendor transactions and copper movement; scripts/vendor.js handles incoming coins events and ledger/purse updates.
scripts/townsfolk.js - each resident's idle/facing state; quest-player owns per-player dialogue sequencing and quest state.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/ui.js and lib/ui-*.js - UI rendering from player/mod state; UI modules do not own persistent character data.
flows: world.config.yaml defaultPlace main-menu-land → MMORPG menu/main-menu-mgr and character-select → creation confirmation → main place/player lifecycle.
Character selection race/class → character state and race start location via mod lib/races.js; player.js and realm-save.js load/upsert the character in the realm characters table.
world.config.yaml player template → humanoid-locomotion → player → vanguard → arcanist → pathfinder → quest-player → vendor; preserve behavior order and shared inputs.
moveX/moveZ/jump plus orbit/steer/autorun inputs → scripts/player.js and wow-move.js room-local intent → body update under place gravity.
attack/cast-slot inputs → Vanguard/Arcanist/Pathfinder abilities and scripts/lib/missiles.js → targets/wolves; Frost Shard writes wolf slowUntil/slowMult.
wolves.js reads wolves.yml and spawns gen/wolf entities → chase/bite/death/respawn; kills award XP and emit coins events to the player's vendor behavior.
quest/interact input → quest-player finds quest NPC, talker, readable, cache or timber target; quest-data/quests.yml drive accept/complete and UI actions.
quest-player completes quest → economy.move copper reward and player quest/xp/tally state → _questSave; MMORPG player.js snapshots and saves character.
quest-player E on timber/cache → per-player inventory/tally, tree depletion or cache claim state; woodcutting.js presents tree fall/regrowth and cache-chest.js presents opening.
Town residents use talker tag and state.who → townsfolk.yml dialogue selected/sequenced by quest-player; townsfolk.js owns resident facing/idle response.
vendor UI actions (buy/sell/tab/close) → scripts/vendor.js and shop-data/economy helpers → purse, inventory and transaction ledger; ui-vendor renders vendorOpen state.
Main place terrain → terrain-reach.js and scatter scripts; regions.js classifies position → HUD region display; keep settlement names/radii/priority aligned with ui-hud.js.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/house.js, props.js, tree.js, rock.js, spire.js, stone-bridge.js, farm.js, windmill*.js, frontier.js, briar.js, quarry.js and reach-*.js - procedural builders reused by scene instances, varied by kind, seed, dimensions and transform.
scripts/grass.js, flower.js and pebble.js - terrain scatter reused by place bindings, varied by density/scale/seed; grass-look supplies material separately.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/player.js, character-select.js and main-menu-mgr.js - coordinated character/menu lifecycle registered by mod.json.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/camera.js and camera-creation.js - gameplay orbit and preview camera modes with creation-phase guards.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ui-*.js - modular panel renderers composed by ui.js for HUD, menu, quest, vendor, inventory, map, character and settings.
scripts/vanguard.js, arcanist.js and pathfinder.js with class data - player combat families selected by class and ability; share target/projectile infrastructure.
scripts/wolves.js with wolves.yml and gen/wolf.js - den manager runs configured pack through shared AI/combat behavior, varied by spawn row and slow/hit state.
scripts/quest-player.js, elric.js, townsfolk.js, vendor.js and woodcutting.js - interaction family across quest NPCs, dialogue residents, vendors and timber, varied by target tags/state.
probableOrphans: scripts/db.js - schema migration helper; current realm-save path does not call migrate.
scripts/lib/data/realms.yml - realm roster definitions have no code consumer identified.
scripts/lib/data/races.yml - race/start-zone table is superseded in use by mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/races.js.
migrationNotes: Money is one integer copper amount; currency helpers format 100 copper = 1 silver and 100 silver = 1 gold. Route earnings/spending through economy/coin handling so purse, ledger and UI stay aligned.
templates/player.js behavior order is significant: locomotion precedes movement, then class behaviors, quests and vendor; gait samples prior-tick movement velocity.
Movement intent and locomotion scratch live in room-local ctx.session; scripts/player.js writes velocity and place config owns gravity.
Core scripts/camera.js uses engine look orientation and feetPosition plus eyeHeight × effectiveScale.y; MMORPG orbit and creation cameras are separate paths.
Persisted character state is built from player state and realm-save signatures; when adding a persistent field, carry it through build/load data and preserve the realm character key.
scripts/lib/regions.js and ui-hud.js independently classify/name settlement regions; keep their circular radii and priority order synchronized.
